summary: Roadzen Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Third Amendment to its Securities Purchase Agreement and junior convertible notes with an institutional investor. The amendment defers installment payments on the November 2025 and January 2026 notes to July 20, 2026, adds a conversion-price adjustment for equity financings below the current rate, and removes a 25% redemption provision tied to subsequent placements. It also extends the investor's participation right to December 2027. The company must seek Nasdaq shareholder approval for potential conversion-related share issuances exceeding 20% of outstanding shares. This filing modifies existing debt terms without constituting a standalone special situation event.
